highpass_definition: RMS of (V-Vref) minus its four-neighbor mean; ground receiver, reference visibility 0.05..0.95, valid ground neighbors. Measures high-frequency error, not a pure noise estimator.

four_beams.limitation: One min/max texture retains only outer surface endpoints. Middle layers and general multi-occluder visibility remain approximate. Smoothing does not recover missing depths.

manifest.shader_programs: separate method programs; CHS kernel and PCF/PCSS smoothing specialized at compile time
manifest.angular_sampling: deterministic radical inverse + golden angle; triangle fan for triangulation
manifest.timing_scope: map generation + shadow evaluation, excludes shared G-buffer, UI and readback
manifest.reference_model: irradiance-weighted angular disk, exact AABB intersections
